## Checklist
- [ ] Tests added or updated; `uv run pytest` passes
- [ ] `uv run ruff check .`, `uv run ruff format --check .` and `uv run mypy src` pass
- [ ] No secrets, real names, emails (only `example.com`), addresses, phone numbers, tenant media or real vendor prices
- [ ] QA agents run on this change (CLAUDE.md Rule 2) and Critical/High findings fixed
- [ ] Relevant docs synced (CLAUDE.md Rule 1)
